items.entity: point load at the middle of the right edge
items.description: Sec. 4.1 only says 'an external force exerted on the middle point of its right edge'. The force direction is shown only in Fig. 7(a). The 'points downward' statement in Sec. 4.2 is about a different model (240×60, Fig. 14).
readings: vertical, downward (−y)
vertical, upward (+y), which gives a mirror-image layout

items.entity: point load at the middle of the right edge
items.description: Neither Sec. 4.1 nor the Fig. 7 caption gives a force value. Sec. 4 only says load data are dimensionless. The value is needed to reproduce C_ref = 92.7 and C = 92.8 (Table 3).
readings: any other constant F (compliance scales with F^2)

items.description: Sec. 4 gives E = 1 and ν = 0.3 for all examples but never says whether the analysis is plane stress or plane strain.
readings: plane stress
plane strain (effective ν about 0.43, effective E = E/(1−ν^2))

items.description: The paper never gives the out-of-plane thickness of the 2D domain.
readings: another constant t (compliance scales with 1/t)

items.description: Eq. (4) only states 0 < ρ_e ≤ 1 with K_e = ρ_e^p K_e^0. No ρ_min or E_min is given.
readings: ρ_min = 1e-3 with E = ρ^3·E0 (classic SIMP)
modified SIMP: E = Emin + ρ^3(E0 − Emin), Emin = 1e-9
ρ_min = 1e-4

items.description: Sec. 3.1 says thickness control uses 'the Heaviside filter [25]'. Sec. 4.1.2 says 'direct usage of a density filter'. Sec. 2.3 uses Heaviside projection only to reach a 0-1 design. The text does not say which filter acts during each phase, or whether the support-needed reference (C_ref) is filtered the same way.
readings: linear (cone) density filter of radius r_min throughout
Guest et al. Heaviside minimum-length-scale projection filter throughout
Sigmund sensitivity filter of radius r_min
density filter for the reference run; Heaviside projection added only in the self-supporting run

items.entity: minimum thickness / filter radius value and meaning
items.description: The Fig. 7 caption says 'minimum thickness of 1.5', and Fig. 11(a) and Table 3 label this r_min = r = 1.5. Sec. 4 says 'minimal thickness is set to be 2' unless specified otherwise. The text does not say whether 1.5 is a filter radius or a member width (presumably in element widths).
readings: filter radius r_min = 1.5 element widths (minimum member width about 3 elements)
member width 1.5 elements, so filter radius about 0.75 (effectively no filtering)
r_min = 2 (Sec. 4 default)

items.description: Secs. 2.3 and 4.1.1 cite Guest et al.'s Heaviside projection but give no projection form, β value, continuation schedule or threshold.
readings: Guest (2004) exponential projection with β continuation 1→2→4→…→64
tanh projection with η = 0.5 and β raised to 32–64
hard 0/1 threshold at 0.5 (β → ∞) applied in one step

items.entity: iteration at which black-white projection starts
items.description: Sec. 2.3 says the black-white filter is applied 'in the last few steps'. Sec. 4.1.1 and Fig. 9(c) show the black-white conversion at step 45 of 166.
readings: switch on at about step 45 (right after the relaxed self-supporting stage) and keep it to the end
apply only in the final 5–10 iterations

items.description: Sec. 2.3 says problem (4) is 'ready-to-solve using the MMA approach'. The text gives no MMA parameters (move limit, asymptotes, constraint scaling) and does not say which optimizer produced the support-needed reference.
readings: MMA with default asymptotes and move limit 0.5
MMA with move limit 0.2
OC update (88-line style) for the reference run, MMA for the self-supporting run

items.description: No starting design is stated. Sec. 4.1.1 and Fig. 10(c) say the volume fraction decreases during the iterations, which suggests the start is above f = 0.6.
readings: uniform ρ = 0.6
uniform ρ = 1.0 (fully solid)

items.description: Only the coarse-stage M_nd criterion is given (Sec. 2.3). Termination of the support-needed reference run and of the final self-supporting run (166 steps in Fig. 9) is not specified.
readings: maximum element density change < 0.01
fixed iteration cap (e.g. 200)
relative compliance change < 1e-3 over several iterations

items.description: Sec. 2.3 defines M_nd with '×100%' but sets M_nd^0 = 0.36, which it says corresponds to an average density of 0.1 or 0.9 (i.e. 36%).
readings: stop the coarse stage when M_nd < 36% (0.36 as a fraction)
stop when M_nd < 0.36% (literal reading)

items.entity: print (build) direction for the self-supporting constraint
items.description: Sec. 4.1 says 'The print direction is determined from left to right' (Sec. 4 says it is marked in the figure). However, the Sec. 2.1 kernel assumes +y, and Secs. 4.1 and 4.1.4 describe unsupported regions and edges 'moving upward', which fits bottom-to-top building.
readings: +x: the clamped left edge is the build plate and the leftmost element column is always supported
+y: bottom-to-top, with the bottom row always supported

items.description: Sec. 2.3 says ε is 'decreased continuously from a relatively large value to the predefined tolerance ε0'. The start value, ε0 and the schedule are not given (Fig. 9 suggests the relaxed stage runs over steps 21–44).
readings: ε starts at U(ρ) of the coarse design and decreases linearly to ε0 = 1e-3 by about step 44
ε multiplied by 0.9 each iteration down to ε0 = 1e-2
ε0 = 0 enforced strictly from step 45 on

items.entity: density threshold replacing 0 in sign function (Eq. 8)
items.description: Sec. 3.2 says that for gray densities 'a specific value usually needs to be set to replace 0 in the sign function', but gives no value.
readings: 1e-3 (any non-void density supports)

items.entity: final strict removal of remaining unsupported elements
items.description: Sec. 2.3 says the remaining unsupported elements (at most 5) are removed 'in the last few iteration steps (when the number ... is no longer decreasing)'. The trigger and the removal method are not defined.
readings: after the count stagnates for several iterations, set the remaining unsupported elements to ρ_min and continue optimizing
set them void once after the last iteration and re-evaluate compliance

items.entity: density field used in U(ρ) and the convolution
items.description: Eq. (6) gives ∂U/∂ρ_e = 2ρ_e but does not say whether ρ is the design variable or the filtered/projected physical density, or whether the chain rule through the filter is applied.
readings: physical (filtered/projected) densities, with sensitivities chained through the filter
raw design variables, using Eq. (6) directly

items.description: The text only says the elements are square (Sec. 2.1; 9000 elements in Table 3). The element formulation and integration are not stated.
readings: 4-node bilinear Q4 with 2×2 Gauss integration
Q4 with incompatible modes (Q6)
8-node Q8
